climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A narrow New York AVA along a free-draining limestone ridge near Lake Ontario, sharing terroir with Canada's Niagara Peninsula. Wines run from Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Chardonnay and Riesling to fruit wines, and Traminette is widely planted in the county.
